# Package that names `entityId`

A package as releases v0.38.0 to v0.41.0 wrote it. Its generated model and
inventories name the Record type of a route, access entry, query operation and
source relation `entityId`, where this release writes `recordType`. The files
are kept byte for byte so the refusal of that shape is tested against a real
package. Its stored source also writes `accessProfiles` as a list.
